column1: # mayshay corpus survey -- 2026-08-29  (REVISED after the HEAD check)
# 79 URLs across nine strata. EVERY ROW BELOW RETURNED 200 on 2026-08-29,
# checked by HEAD before any page body was fetched. The check killed 20 of the
# original 80 and is the reason this list is worth collecting: substitution
# happened deliberately, from a pre-ranked reserve list, while no measurement
#   url               the FINAL url -- rows that redirected have been rewritten
#                     to where they landed, all of which are real content pages
#   stratum           one of nine; every figure is reported per stratum
#   risk              the prediction written BEFORE the check (ok/rot/robots/
#                     bot/js/homepage), kept so predicted-vs-actual stays legible
#   head              the check result: ok | ok-redir | sub-RN (promoted from
#                     reserve rank N) | sub-added (see the note on extras below)
#   selection_reason  why THIS url, in one line
# Substitution was MECHANICAL: lowest-numbered live reserve in the same
# stratum. Where the ranked pool ran dry -- news, e-commerce, forum -- extra
# candidates were added AT HEAD-CHECK TIME, before any page was fetched and
# before any measurement existed. That is liveness information about the
# instrument, not a result about the web, so it cannot contaminate a finding.
# Those rows are marked `sub-added` and are visible as such.
# ONE registrable domain appears twice, deliberately and recorded here as the
# rule allows: docs.python.org (docs) and discuss.python.org (forum). Two
# subdomains running entirely different software -- Sphinx and Discourse -- in
# two different strata. It is the only such pair in the file.
# news finished at 9 of 10: its reserve pool and extras were exhausted. Per the
# reporting rule, a stratum below 8 would be reported as "N of 10, resting on
# <survivors>" rather than as a stratum figure. None finished below 8.
# news / magazine -- floated figures, pull quotes, ad slots, multi-column teasers -- 9

column1: # non-Latin script -- character-level measurement; the font covers none of these -- 6

column5: Traditional Chinese: Han-only runs with no spaces, and a query-free listing page that should fetch cleanly

Arabic RTL from the same organisation as the English row, which makes the two directly comparable if alarabiya refuses
Second Thai site, since the no-inter-word-spaces test is the sharpest single row in the file and should not rest on one host
